summary: Complete outage of checkout-service, all customers affected
description: checkout-service is returning 500s for every request starting 09:14 UTC. No checkouts are completing. Load balancer health checks are failing on all pods.
resolution: Rolled back the 09:10 UTC deploy which introduced a bad DB connection pool config. Service recovered within 6 minutes of rollback. Postmortem filed; added a canary stage before full rollout.

summary: Unauthorized access to internal admin panel detected
description: Security monitoring flagged repeated login attempts from an unrecognized IP range against the internal admin panel, with two successful logins using a decommissioned service account.
resolution: Revoked the service account credentials immediately, rotated all admin panel secrets, and blocked the source IP range at the WAF. Confirmed no data was exfiltrated via audit logs. Filed a security incident report.

summary: Customer PII exposed in support ticket export
description: A CSV export feature in the support dashboard included customer email addresses and phone numbers in a field that was supposed to be redacted for the 'analyst' role.
resolution: Disabled the export feature pending a fix, purged the generated CSV from shared storage, and notified the privacy team. Fixed the redaction logic to apply server-side rather than client-side.

description: During the flash sale, roughly 8% of order-service requests returned 502 Bad Gateway. Errors cleared once traffic dropped after 30 minutes.
resolution: Root cause was connection pool exhaustion against the orders DB during peak load. Increased pool size and added autoscaling triggers based on connection saturation, not just CPU.

summary: Billing double-charged a batch of customers
description: A retry in the billing worker did not check for idempotency, causing roughly 40 customers to be charged twice for the same invoice.
resolution: Issued refunds to all affected customers, added an idempotency key to the charge-retry path, and added a reconciliation job that flags duplicate charges within 24h.

summary: Search results ranking noticeably degraded for product queries
description: Users report that search results for common product queries are showing irrelevant items in the top 5, following a re-index run last night.
resolution: The re-index job used a stale synonym dictionary. Reverted to the previous index snapshot and re-ran the job with the correct dictionary version.

summary: Footer copyright year still shows last year
description: The footer on the marketing site shows the previous year instead of the current year.
resolution: Updated the hardcoded year constant and replaced it with a dynamic current-year computation so this doesn't recur.

summary: Typo in password reset email subject line
description: The password reset email subject reads 'Reset Your Passwrod' due to a typo introduced in the last copy update.
resolution: Corrected the copy in the email template and added the string to the copy-review checklist.

summary: Slow page load on user profile page for large accounts
description: Users with more than 500 saved addresses report the profile page taking 8-10 seconds to load, well above the 2s target.
resolution: Added pagination to the saved-addresses query instead of loading all rows, and added an index on the addresses table's account_id column.

summary: Notification emails delayed by up to 20 minutes
description: Transactional emails (order confirmation, shipping updates) are being delivered 15-20 minutes late instead of within 1 minute.
resolution: The email queue consumer had scaled down overnight due to an overly aggressive autoscaling policy. Adjusted the minimum replica count and added a queue-depth alert.
